reuse.reason: The pinned official command popup has no unavailable option contract. Fork its complete browser implementation and add only disabled/disabledReason Host capability fields: keep unavailable model rows visible and explained, skip them during keyboard navigation, and reject pointer/keyboard/confirmation settlement before invoking the original callback. All other official command behavior, rendering, localization and slots remain unchanged. A seam cannot disable individual rows through the original public contract.
gaps: Deployment-unavailable choices remain visible and disabled with Host-localized reasons; no runtime command or model selection is simulated.
